scope.purpose: Produce authorization-gated, content-free, deterministic, bounded views of compiled decisions, lifecycle state, and non-success reasons without exposing graph or session values.
admitted_subjects: an admitted immutable compiled private plan or a content-free admission rejection receipt
an owner-issued immutable invocation snapshot at an allowed lifecycle capture point
a content-free terminal accounting or cleanup receipt
excluded_subjects: legacy pandas dataframe or trace dataframe

explain.question_answered: Which closed profile, route, requirements, bounds, and aggregate graph relationships did compilation select or reject, and which closed rule caused rejection?

inspect.question_answered: What aggregate bounded lifecycle, stage, terminal, reconciliation, cleanup, and release state has the owning runtime accepted at one capture point?
forbidden: direct read of a live mutable ledger

diagnose.question_answered: Which closed content-free reason categories explain an admission rejection or accepted non-success outcome, at which closed boundary and stage, with what bucketed impact?
subjects: content-free terminal accounting or cleanup receipt

view_semantics.overlap_rule: Each operation has one purpose and one schema variant; callers must not receive a union of all three views from one request.
view_semantics.no_success_claim: A view reports accepted state only; it cannot establish exhaustive PII detection, provider behavior, secure erasure, product authorization, or release eligibility beyond the owning terminal record.

authorization.precondition: The integrating product or execution host authorizes source access and field use before graph construction; Anonymizer does not accept or interpret product identity, credential, token, or field-authorization claims.
authorization.inspection_grant: A separate process-local opaque capability attests only that its issuer permits one bounded private inspection operation over one already-owned subject.
grant_properties: fresh and unforgeable by supported callers
bound by object identity to one owner and one subject
bound to exactly one operation from explain inspect diagnose
expires when the owning capture operation returns or the subject closes, whichever occurs first
authorization.validation_order: Validate grant type, issuer seal, operation, subject binding, single-use state, and lifetime before subject lookup or traversal.
authorization.same_process_security_limit: This capability is a supported-call-path control, not a security boundary against arbitrary code executing in the same Python interpreter.
authorization.issuance_condition: The execution host may mint a grant only after the integrating product has authorized source and field access.

privacy_and_redaction.construction_rule: Build every view from closed content-free receipts and allowlisted primitives; never build a rich view and redact it afterward.
forbidden_values: original target or context text and any substring
detected entity text labels offsets mentions clusters roles obligations or dispositions
replacement values baselines revisions prompts and evaluation text
graph datum source row group scope task attempt member mention binding obligation slot bundle capability invocation session process thread trace or artifact identities
private correlation or lineage tokens and token maps
credentials endpoints model names provider payloads and provider usage bodies
exception type module args message cause context traceback and stack
contract plan prompt graph payload or artifact digest
filesystem path hostname environment value and memory address
allowed_scalar_types: nonnegative bounded integer for schema-declared limits only
allowed_dimensions: closed route boundary stage lifecycle terminal reason reconciliation cleanup and release states
bucketed counts for datums relationships stages tasks groups operations repairs outcomes and retained references

enforcement: validate the grant before subject access
validate the subject kind and capture point before snapshot construction
enforce record counts and builder bytes while constructing
build only a schema-specific detached payload from validated private values
enforce exact built-in payload field depth and per-string UTF-8 ceilings before exact schema and closed-value admission
encode once into canonical JSON and enforce the exact encoded byte limit before return
limits.exceeded_limit: return no constructed view for a construction-time record or builder ceiling violation; return no encoded bytes for a detached-payload or canonical-byte ceiling violation and do not revoke an existing immutable view; use the cause-free closed code inspection_limit_exceeded; malformed or unknown structures and values within measured ceilings return inspection_redaction_failed
limits.fixed_arity_enforcement: The private explain inspect and diagnose functions accept exactly one scalar subject and return exactly one scalar view or rejection; no batch request or multi-view shape exists.

payload_limit_measurement.domain: detached payloads built only by schema-specific Phase 10 builders from validated private values
payload_limit_measurement.top_level_fields: count exact string keys in the root exact built-in dictionary
payload_limit_measurement.provenance_fields: count exact string keys in the exact built-in provenance dictionary
payload_limit_measurement.json_nesting_depth: root dictionary has container depth 1; entering an exact built-in dictionary or list adds 1; scalar values do not add depth
payload_limit_measurement.allowlisted_string_utf8_bytes: measure each exact string key and each exact string value separately as the length of its UTF-8 encoding; do not aggregate strings
payload_limit_measurement.static_schema_ceiling_evidence: when the current closed schema cannot naturally reach a ceiling, require direct exact and one-over tests of the authoritative measurement primitive, full-encoder tests with the ceiling lowered to the actual value and one less, and a mutation proving every encoder variant invokes the validator

failure_precedence: exact built-in detached payload shell and measured payload ceilings
exact schema keys and closed allowlisted values

deterministic_ordering.source: admitted compiler order and closed enum declaration order only
deterministic_ordering.terminal_summary_rows: compiled stage order then terminal precedence
deterministic_ordering.diagnostic_entries: boundary order then compiled stage order then terminal precedence then reason declaration order then impact bucket order
deterministic_ordering.reason_codes: closed reason declaration order with duplicates aggregated into one bucketed entry
deterministic_ordering.permutation_property: Semantically equivalent declaration, row, mapping, and terminal-evidence permutations produce byte-identical canonical views unless declared order is itself part of the admitted semantic contract.

lifecycle_and_cancellation.capture_atomicity: The owning runtime issues one immutable content-free snapshot under its lifecycle serialization rule; failure to prove a coherent capture returns no view.
lifecycle_and_cancellation.cleanup_interference: Inspection must not delay cleanup, retain cleanup-owned objects, or weaken release embargoes.

inspection_request_cancellation.availability: no cancellable asynchronous or multi-view inspection request exists in Phase 10 v1
inspection_request_cancellation.view_publication_linearization_point: successful return from the synchronous private inspection function
inspection_request_cancellation.view_construction_failure: an internal denial limit redaction or state failure before operation return discards builder state and returns no view
inspection_request_cancellation.byte_publication_linearization_point: successful return from the private canonical encoder
inspection_request_cancellation.encoding_failure: a detached-payload limit redaction or encoding failure returns no encoded bytes and cannot revoke an existing immutable view
inspection_request_cancellation.after_view_publication: the returned immutable view cannot be rewritten or revoked

lifecycle_and_cancellation.inspection_failure_non_interference: Inspection denial, limit, redaction, encoding, or cancellation failure cannot change task, datum, group, invocation, cleanup, release, result, exception, or telemetry behavior.
lifecycle_and_cancellation.post_cleanup: Only an owner-retained content-free terminal receipt may be inspected; no graph plan ledger workframe candidate or provider object may be revived.

serialization.private_inputs: graph plan grant ledger runtime snapshot and receipt objects remain non-serializable and content-masking in repr
serialization.view_object: immutable private value with content-masking repr and pickle disabled
serialization.supported_output: one internal canonical JSON UTF-8 byte encoding of the allowlisted view
serialization.numeric_values: nonnegative bounded integers only for declared hard limits; no float NaN Infinity duration timestamp or arbitrary counter
serialization.schema_compatibility: exact schema version match only; no unknown fields and no silent upgrade downgrade or aliasing

provenance.claim: The record identifies the closed schema and semantic capture class, not the underlying data, invocation, process, or artifact.

phase12_public_surface.name: Public Surface Qualification and Publication
phase12_public_surface.phase10_role: prepare and verify private bounded inspection semantics without defining a publication-receipt subject or publishing a graph or session surface
phase12_public_surface.phase11_role: supply process-backed lifecycle evidence and materially different semantic runtime conformance evidence
phase12_public_surface.phase12_role: freeze review and implement an exact public graph session and inspection contract under separate public API authority

failure_diagnostics.mapping: Every admitted owning-domain reason maps explicitly to exactly one Phase 10 category; unmapped or newly added reasons map only to unexpected_failure and fail the contract-conformance gate.
failure_diagnostics.unknown_failure_behavior: return only unexpected_failure with closed boundary and terminal state when available
